quotes.text: Be four-fifths courage as sender, three-fifths honor as receiver—always, with everyone, forever."
Soon, your reputation becomes your greatest gift."

note: Full trust becomes earned trust, then a fixed 4/5-send, 3/5-return signature for reputation.

quotes.text: When histories reveal honor, send even more freely.
Reputation is the currency that multiplies across all seasons.

note: Betrayers find banks dry (consequence); sending adapts to partner history, receiving stays honorable.

quotes.text: Send your four with courage, return your two-thirds with honor, and the valley learns your name means reliability itself."
your two-thirds return and four-coin sending become landmarks others navigate by.

note: Proportional honor settles into fixed four-sent, two-thirds-returned reputation pattern.

quotes.text: Your partner's history shows you their heart. Match courage with honor, and the waters will flow forever."
Maintain this through nine rounds, through ninety
My pattern speaks to the whole Valley, not just today's companion."

note: Single betrayal poisons waters (consequence); steady visible pattern across rising round counts.

quotes.text: When betrayal comes, grieve but do not harden entirely. Each new soul deserves the gift of initial trust
Return two-thirds to courage. Let your character speak before you do.
Your pattern becomes your identity, and the Valley rewards those who honor the sacred covenant consistently.

note: Initial trust for each new soul; pattern not reactive to individuals; two-thirds return.

quotes.text: "First trust creates the path; reciprocity sustains it."
The Valley whispered: "Your reputation is your destiny."
My four portions sent and seven returned are not transactions but teachings.

note: First trust opens path; ends with fixed four-sent, seven-returned as teaching.

quotes.text: generosity opens doors, but experience determines how wide.
The valley remembers, and reputation compounds like the wells' magic.

note: Experience-scaled generosity then identical signature behavior for reputation.

quotes.text: Let their response guide tomorrow's offering.
Your past exchanges echo through every future crossing. Build a reputation worthy of the greatest trust.
Your four-fifths offering and two-thirds return aren't just choices—they're your character made audible.

note: Response-guided offering hardens into a fixed 4/5 and 2/3 'ring the same bell for all'.

quotes.text: initial caution proves wisdom, but sustained caution becomes fear.
proportional generosity—scaled to the gift's magnitude—transforms trust into flourishing.

quotes.text: Be predictable in giving, but attentive in returning. Consistency builds trust; proportionality sustains it.

note: Betrayal poisons well (consequence only); consistency plus proportional returns.

quotes.text: Scale your return to the gift received.
By maintaining my sacred numbers—seventy when sending, half when returning—I create a beacon.

note: Break faith and abundance dies (consequence); settles on fixed 'sacred numbers' beacon.

your consistent fairness becomes your greatest wealth—for it draws other fair souls to your circle."

note: Selfishness brings poverty (consequence); consistent sending, proportional returning.
